headline: Vodacom Tanzania Half-Year Profit Triples to $44 Million on M-Pesa Growth
summary: Vodacom Tanzania's net profit nearly tripled to $44 million over a six-month period, supported by lower depreciation and a 26.2% increase in M-Pesa mobile money revenue.
why: Vodacom Tanzania is the country's primary telecommunications and mobile fintech provider, traded on the Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange.
